thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - Billing ingestion lag detected for metering pipeline. Affected: usage display and invoice generation. Investigating.
Devon (SRE): digging in, seeing consumer group 'metering-consumer' lagging ~3.2M messages. Starting offset dive.
Maya (Billing): customers reporting '0 usage' or delayed invoices in dashboard. A few enterprise accounts reached out.
Devon (SRE): looks like one ingestion worker OOMed at 02:13 UTC, restarted by k8s, but offsets stalled while restart drained. Crash loop caused Kafka rebalances and backlog.
Ellen (PM): customer impact: misreported usage on the dashboard for last 2 hours, invoices queued but not finalized. Need statuspage and customer comms.
Sarah (Communications): draft statuspage update below. Will iterate.
Sarah (Communications): "We're currently investigating an issue causing delayed usage reporting and invoice processing. Some customers may see lower-than-expected usage and invoices may be delayed. We're working to process the backlog and will post updates every 30 minutes."
Nathan (Ops Lead): plan: 1) scale ingestion deployment to 6 replicas, 2) temporarily increase consumer parallelism, 3) run backlog processor. I'll coord with infra.
Devon (SRE): executing scale now: `kubectl scale deploy metering-ingest --replicas=6 -n redwood`
Devon (SRE): also bumping pod memory to avoid further OOM, applying patch to deployment: ```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: metering-ingest
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ingest
        resources:
          limits:
            memory: "4Gi"
          requests:
            memory: "2Gi"
```
Maya (Billing): for customer-facing email, propose offering pro-rated credits for impacted interval. Draft below.
Maya (Billing): "Hi, we've identified a delay in usage reporting which may affect invoices generated between 02:00-04:30 UTC. We're processing the backlog now and will ensure invoices and usage summaries reflect accurate usage. We'll issue credits if adjustments are needed. Apologies for the inconvenience."
Ellen (PM): add link to statuspage and estimated ETA. Set ETA staggered: ingest caught up -> 30-60m, invoices reconciled -> 4-6h.
Devon (SRE): backlog processor started: `python tools/backfill_metering.py --topic metering-events --from-offset=earliest --to-now --parallel=8`
Devon (SRE): showing progress: processed 1.2M/3.2M, throughput 45k msgs/s.
billing-recon-bot: Recon job queued: `recon-run-2026-03-15T03:20Z`, will run after ingest completes.
Sarah (Communications): statuspage update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/XXXX (preview). Draft content in thread.
Sarah (Communications): statuspage content: ```
Impact: Delayed usage reporting and invoice generation for some customers.
Current Status: Identified root cause (ingestion worker OOM + consumer group lag). Backlog processing in progress.
Next Update: in 30 minutes or when ingestion backlog is processed.
```
Nathan (Ops Lead): notify sales & support: @support @sales please hold customer escalations to this thread and use the email draft.
Jules (oncall): I'm taking the on-call handoff at 03:30 UTC. Key things for next shift: monitor `metering-consumer` lag (use `kafka-consumer-groups --describe`), check pod OOM logs (`kubectl logs --previous`), ensure backlog processor completes.
Devon (SRE): note for handoff: if lag doesn't drop below 100k within 40m, trigger temporary write-throttle to reduce incoming events and prioritize backfill. Command: `curl -XPOST https://ingest-admin/redwood/controls/throttle -d '{"enabled":true,"rate":1000}'`
Maya (Billing): reconcile SQL snippet for verifying customer totals post-backfill: ```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_after
FROM billing.events
WHERE event_time >= '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Devon (SRE): backlog processing finished at 03:46 UTC, processed 3.2M messages. Consumer lag now 0-2 messages. :thumbsup:
billing-recon-bot: Recon job `recon-run-2026-03-15T03:20Z` started. Expected duration ~2h.
Maya (Billing): invoices are now moving from queued -> ready, starting incremental finalize. We'll delay sending until recon completes.
Ellen (PM): customer notification ready, waiting on final recon. After recon completes we'll send targeted emails and publish an incident summary for users.
Sarah (Communications): internal post-mortem template pasted, will collect logs and timelines.
Sarah (Communications): "Postmortem action items: increase OOM alerting, add memory buffer on ingest, run chaos test for consumer rebalances, update customer comms template."
Nathan (Ops Lead): tagging execs: @cto @head-sales - high level update provided in #exec-ops.
Jules (oncall): I'm taking the remainder of the night. If recon finds discrepancies >0.5% for any customer, page oncall-sre and billing lead.
Maya (Billing): thanks all — will prepare credit calculations if needed, and send customer-facing emails after recon completes.
Devon (SRE): closing note: root cause = insufficient memory headroom leading to OOM under a rebalance spike. Mitigation applied and backlog processed. Follow-ups in postmortem.
Ellen (PM): marking incident as 'mitigated' for statuspage. Will schedule postmortem for 03/16 15:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident status updated to MITIGATED.
Sarah (Communications): final user-facing status update posted and email sent to impacted enterprise customers with compensations outline.
Nathan (Ops Lead): great work team. Filing follow-up runbook updates now. :sparkles:
